## PasswordInput.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The password. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new text whenever it changes.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted, and sets the scale of the Caps Lock hint.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the reveal button; muted by default so it stays an affordance beside the value.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the strength meter's label, one step below the field's own text.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. @default 'modern'
- `variant` :: `outline` is a bordered field, `secondary` a tinted one without a border, `ghost` is bare until hovered or focused. @default 'outline'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field invalid (red border, `aria-invalid`). Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `strength` :: Shows a strength meter under the field, scored from the length and the mix of character classes.
- `gap` :: The space between the field and the strength meter below it.
- `ref` :: The underlying `<input>` element. Bindable.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the frame.
